events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, with four scenarios for geopolitics after the war. The US military strength is being tested, but its geopolitical power is waning. The Middle East is a powder keg of instability and strategic rivalries.
events.reasoning: The Iran war escalation will lead to increased demand for defense stocks and a decrease in oil prices. The iShares Aerospace & Defense ETF (ITA) is a good buy, while the VanEck Vectors Oil Services ETF (OIH) is a good short.

timeFrame.note: Watch for a ceasefire or a significant escalation

events.exitStrategy: Exit when the war ends or when the oil price stabilizes
